theorem.raw_regularity_no_go: The literal full symmetric current has a nonzero strict low-high principal coefficient. After divergence its variance is asymptotically constant on a cone, so its truncated H^{-1-kappa} second moment grows as Lambda^{1-2kappa}; the kappa=1/10 attribution in R-070 is false for pp and non-pp pieces and covariance centering cannot remove it.
theorem.polynomial_core: The nominal non-pp block contains (2q12+q22) P Kp, and the complete polynomial core is (q11+2q12+q22) P Kp. Both coefficients are nonzero at the production point.
theorem.one_form_lift: For every smooth finite matrix one-form with polynomial-growth derivatives at fixed floor, common real-even spectral approximations converge canonically in every finite Lp(Omega;H^{-1/2-delta}). The reconstruction uses exactly the R-050 Gaussian second level and has no first-derivative current counterterm.
theorem.covariance_normal_divergence: The exact split div[f(U) grad U]=Df(U):(grad U tensor grad U-Gamma)+f(U) diamond Delta U retains two opposite covariance terms. A balanced derivative-square jet may not be cited while deleting the Wick second-derivative current.
theorem.symmetric_payment: R-068 extends to every 1<s<2 with eta exponent 3s/[2(2-s)] and model moment 3/(2-s). At s=8/5 the full symmetric frame is paid once with eta^{-6}, zeta^{-1/2}, and moment 15/2.
theorem.cartan_payment: The Cartan coefficient is also a matrix one-form current at H^{-1/2-delta}. At delta=1/10 its corrected payment uses eta^{-39/4}, zeta^{-1/2}, and moment 45/4. All moments are finite.
theorem.linear_subgate: The complete Q_II-weighted symmetric and Cartan linear frame in R-070 is closed at fixed floor by the one-form Sobolev lift and generalized one-use interpolations.
theorem.kernel_leakage: An exact six-real production fixture has a derivative direction in the common terminal-frame kernel while the nonlinear coefficient-remainder slope is 27(6e^2+22e+27)/[400(e+3)^3]>0. The terminal square is blind to this direction, and R_shift is affine and unbounded below along it.
theorem.refined_successor: The remaining finite-cutoff theorem is an integrated strict-past range/kernel grouped estimate. It must pay the kernel leakage using Cameron-Martin H2 cost and causal frequency structure, retain the range-visible part in the positive square, use a tip-safe whole secant, and spend no Malliavin derivatives or per-shell random constants.

successor: Prove the integrated strict-past terminal-frame kernel-leakage estimate with one Cameron-Martin allocation, one terminal sextic allocation, and one integrable random constant; then extend regular controls by localization and lower semicontinuity before assembling controlled-shell one-use and Nelson.
honesty_boundary: This scoped T4 continuation proves the fixed-floor matrix one-form Sobolev lift, corrects and closes the complete R-070 symmetric and Cartan linear frame, and exactly falsifies pointwise terminal-square absorption of the nonlinear coefficient remainder. It does not prove the integrated strict-past kernel-leakage bound, extend to every finite-energy drift, close controlled-shell one-use or the q=10/9 Nelson theorem, construct an interacting measure, remove the floor or regulator, take infinite volume, or justify T5, T6, or T7.
